integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact facet decomposition into two cones, join description of their intersection, explicit uniform elementary collapses to graphs and a homotopy-pushout equivalence.
integrity.reproducibility: Run python3 verify_projective_cech.py using Python 3 standard library; verification_output.txt records one successful run.

scientific_limitations: Conditional on the existence of a finite projective plane of the given order; no existence assertion for unavailable orders.

The result concerns intrinsic graph Čech nerves of vertex-centered balls in the geometric realization; it does not cover arbitrary partial planes, Vietoris–Rips complexes, or the full lower-scale Čech filtration.
Finite checks cover prime orders two and three; the all-orders and integral statements rely on the written structural proof.
Unindexed mathematically equivalent results remain a bibliographic risk.
title: Scale-four graph Čech nerves of finite projective planes
